{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Stone Smasher Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Stone Smasher Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 42 |durability= 40 |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Stone Smashers''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Stone Smasher|Stone Smashers|Series, BotW, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 42 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Stone Smasher}} Stone Smashers are two-handed [[Weapon]]s made by the [[Goron]]s in [[Goron City]]. They belong to the [[Goron Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created and used by the Gorons. Their center of gravity is at their tip, so they use centrifugal force to deal damage. A Stone Smasher has the attack damage of 42. Like other hammer-type Weapons, the Smashers can break [[Ore Deposit]]s with one hit. Mining ores in this manner was the Gorons' intended purpose when crafting them, as the name suggests. Because Gorons are much stronger and larger than [[Hylian]], they can wield these Weapons one-handed. [[Link]], however, needs both hands to use one. Stone Smashers have a hidden property which causes their damage output to be doubled when used on the Ore Deposit atop a [[Stone Talus]]. Similarly, they are capable of immediately destroying [[Stone Pebblit]]s. Though they are commonly found around Goron City in [[Eldin Canyon]], two Stone Smashers can be found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. One of them is wielded by a [[Black Moblin]] in the [[Dining Hall]], and the other is in a hidden chamber connected to the [[Library]]. A Stone Smasher can also be found when a {{BotW|-}} Series [[Daruk]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Stone Smashers are made from metal, and they will therefore conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will also sink if dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up again using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Finally, they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_037" |Life = 40 |Power = 42 |SpHitActor = "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint", "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint_02", "Enemy_Golem_R_WeakPoint" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = true |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 17 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 80 |BuyingPrice = 325 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Daruk Weapon }} The Stone Smasher is a two handed [[Goron]] [[Weapon]] wielded by [[Daruk]].
